overview_description.description:
Mrayti is Jordan’s first specialized mobile beauty salon. Mrayti was launched with a vision that beauty should be accessible, affordable, and non time consuming. 
With Mrayti, Hair cuts, Hair Styling, Makeup and much more are now available to women in their houses, offices, and gatherings wherever they are and whenever they want.
